# AEC Model Bridge

> AEC Model Bridge is an open-source Revit MCP server and native Revit add-in. It lets AI assistants such as Claude, Codex and Cursor read and edit the Revit model you have open. Every change goes through a plan that you approve first. It supports Revit 2024 to 2027 and also reads IFC files, with Rhino, Grasshopper and Speckle integrations.

Key facts:

- Protocol: Model Context Protocol (MCP), stdio transport. Any MCP client that can start a local server can use it.
- Tools: 302 in the default setup, counted in mock mode. Revit has 110 of them.
- Safety: tools that change the model are blocked until a plan is approved. This is the default. An unattended mode exists and is opt-in.
- Platform: live Revit work needs Windows and a licensed Revit. Mock mode needs neither.
- Licence: GPL-3.0 with a commercial option.
- Maintainer: A. Sam Mohammad.
